'''The Nest''', sometimes known as the '''K'lor' Nest''', was the district of [[Point Nadir]] that housed the rougher elements of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

If a brawl or firefight were to break out on Point Nadir, the odds were good that it was in the Nest. Unlike the open spaces of the rest of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the Nest consisted of narrow and winding corridors and alleys. It was easily the most dangerous district in the whole town, frequented by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Thug/Legends|thugs]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and every form of low-life imaginable.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
